description: This Python source file defines an asynchronous frame processor class 'AsyncGeneratorProcessor' used within a streaming framework. The class serializes frames, passes them through a processing pipeline, and provides an asynchronous generator interface for streaming serialized data to external consumers.

classes.name: AsyncGeneratorProcessor
classes.description: A frame processor that serializes frames and exposes an async generator for streaming serialized data, enabling concurrent processing and data streaming.
